exposure: advanced maternal age (>30 years old, specifically >35 years old)
cohort: The study included 1257 pregnant women from the National Guard Hospital in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, whose delivery records were collected between January 1st and March 31st, 2019.
finding: Advanced maternal age is associated with a range of adverse pregnancy and fetal outcomes, including a higher risk for needing CS.
mod_finding: Older women (>35 years) had a higher risk for needing CS (41.5%) compared to younger participants (28.5%).
